question: Can learned or hybrid representations preserve functionally relevant Korean structure across time/source/script shift without collapsing into corpus, period, publisher, script or observation-channel identity?

F0.pooling: attention-mask mean pool last hidden state + L2

model_revision_rule: Resolve exact Hugging Face repository SHA at job start, record it before encoding any packet text, and load that exact revision.

common_filters: keyword tuple contains 기사 when keyword field is available
public_okhc_packet.deterministic_sample: 64 lowest SHA-256(id || fixed salt) documents per regime×year

tokenizer_observability: UNK token fraction where tokenizer exposes UNK
weak_content_proxy: same-document first-half ↔ second-half retrieval recall@1 and MRR for texts with sufficient length
metrics.authority_note: High nuisance predictability is an identity-collapse risk, not an automatic benefit.

long_context_note: F3 long-context capacity is not granted authority from model specification alone. This public packet uses max_length 512 for parity; long-context advantage requires a separate evidence-bearing stress within P47 if needed.

hard_constraint_eligible: R2 fields with PROMOTED authority inside validity region
forbidden: UNKNOWN/HOLD semantic role as hard fact
unsupported discourse label as hard fact
period/source/script label as semantic target by default
